'''Benja Da'aapp''' was a [[Gruvian]] tourist often seen at [[Kuat Passenger Port]]. Da'aapp was always accompanied by [[Olall Da'aapp]], though it is unclear how they were related. Both Gruvians were gregarious and talkative, often adopting random passing [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] as traveling companions, telling them endless tales of the places they had visited, and getting them to take pictures of them with one of their many recording devices.
